blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Dining out and commuting by public transportation were a bit pricey in October, as shown by inflation rates of 9.3 percent in Baguio City and 9.2 percent in the Cordillera region. The October inflation was the highest rate yet this year for the mountain resort city and the highland provinces of Ifugao, Abra, Apayao, Benguet, Mountain Province, and Kalinga, and its component Tabuk City, said Aldrin Federico Bahit Jr., chief statistician of the Philippine Statistics Authority for the Cordillera, during a briefing on Thursday.
